description: Lanes expected to fail, read by ninjars case-check (--known-failures) and the rank n+2 tests. lanes: an upstream bug in a master integral; the lane is compared with COLLIER's COLI quad value (collier_coli_quad_decimal) at a loose scaled tolerance (1e-6, --known-failure-tolerance): known-failure while they differ by more, stale-known-failure (a failure) once they agree or the lane passes its own tolerance, so that the entry is removed. An entry may name the engines (fast, generic) and precisions (f64, double, float:<bits>) it applies to (engines, precisions; every one when absent); elsewhere the lane is judged as any other. Empty since oneloopmaster 09b2c74, which fixes the real-mass D0 of README findings 3 and 5 (24 lanes, removed; README "Known failures"). inaccuracies: one engine at one fixed precision misses the lane's budget (README "Tolerances") although the reference is right: known-failure while the scaled difference stays within limit, a failure beyond it, and stale-known-failure once the lane is within its tolerance. A lane may have one entry per engine and precision. ninja_unreliable: kinematics (lane id without rank and mu^2 tags) where original Ninja's errors, the binary64 budget of the policy, contain OneLOop's own D0 error; errors (by rank excess) are Ninja's errors with that removed, i.e. against the exact reduction with oneloopmaster fe550e3's identically wrong D0, and replace Ninja's errors; without errors the kinematics have no Ninja budget.

inaccuracies.reason: the generic engine in binary64 is off by 4.3e-7 (4.26e-7 with oneloopmaster 09b2c74), 640 times original Ninja's error (6.7e-10) and 1200 times the fast engine's (3.7e-10), at COLLIER condition 7.2; the same with the shift invariants in place of the snapped S-matrix, so not the input ambiguity, and not cancellation between cut contributions (case-check --stability-test passes); DoubleFloat, Float(128) and Float(256) agree with the reference within its uncertainty (1.5e-11). The rank 6 twin is fine (4.1e-10); the rank 8 lane is report-only (its new rank n+2 terms are 5e7 times the lane). Not traced.

ninja_unreliable.reason: README finding 3: OneLOop's D0 (as oneloopmaster's before 09b2c74) has the wrong real part for one real-mass box of this lane, so original Ninja's errors on rn2-int-mixed-n6-r{5,6,7} lane 1 (0.10, 0.30, 0.24) measure that bug. errors: Ninja against the generic engine in Float(256) with oneloopmaster fe550e3's exact masters (the same wrong D0); the same comparison reproduces Ninja's published errors on lanes 0 and 2 of these cases to 4 digits.

README finding 5: OneLOop's D0 has the wrong real part for two real-mass boxes of this lane (original Ninja's errors on rn2-int-real-n7-r{6,7,8} lane 0: 3.4, 0.77, 0.90). OneLOop's wrong values differ from oneloopmaster fe550e3's here (Ninja against the fe550e3 reduction: 1.5, 0.41, 0.51), so no corrected errors: no Ninja budget (all lanes on these kinematics are tier C).
